sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: Link previews on other sites (discogs.com, setlist.fm, archive.org, the Springsteen sites): a country in a window's area line now shows its real flag instead of its two-letter code in a box (images from flagcdn.com, as majkinetor's Event Horizon does, asked only once a window opens). Codes with no flag there, such as XE (Europe) and XW (Worldwide), keep the box, and so does a flag the site blocks. On musicbrainz.org MusicBrainz's own flags stay, and Lotheric's "Right Side Flags" and "More Flags Everywhere" still leave the windows alone.

Link previews: an area's window now starts its Facts with "Part of", the whole line above it with flags ("New Jersey, United States" for Long Branch), asked in one request (WIP.1). Once a window has it, the area's hover card names that line too instead of only the nearest parent.

sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: Link previews: a window now names an area's whole line ("Long Branch, New Jersey, United States") from one request instead of one request per level. It asks MusicBrainz's website for the area and everything above it (as majkinetor's Event Horizon does), about 1 KB, where the climb asked three lookups of about 30 KB together, each waiting for its one-a-second turn. Artist, label, place, event and recording windows all get it, and every area of the line is remembered, so a label in New Jersey asks nothing more. If the website does not answer, or answers with its browser check, the window climbs level by level as before, for the rest of that page. A hover card still asks nothing for the line.
